next.reason: Reopening in any mode after a CLOSE is kept: §2023:14.9.27.4 GR2 'The file connector referenced by file-name-1 shall not be open' (else status 41), GR4 sets the mode per INPUT/OUTPUT/I-O/EXTEND, and §2023:14.9.6.4 GR8 leaves the connector 'no longer in an open mode'. The 1985 qualifier 'CLOSE statement, without the LOCK phrase' and its status 38 (§1985:VIII.1.3.4) have no 2023 carrier: the 2023 CLOSE format (§2023:14.9.6.2) has no WITH LOCK, so the bar on reopening a file closed with lock is gone.
